title: Nourishing Velvety American Pasta Bake
description: A comforting American dish featuring a citrusy and velvety creme-patissiere sauce, al-dente pasta, and a low-sodium friendly recipe, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta al-dente according to package instructions.
In a large saucepan, combine the creme-patissiere mix, milk, and grated cheddar cheese, and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the grated parmesan cheese, fresh lemon zest, and salt-free seasoning blend.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, velvety sauce, and a drizzle of olive oil, and toss until the pasta is well coated.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Bake the pasta in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the pasta from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
